text_block_list.text:
Today is the start of summer camp,
where the
Umamusume train to improve
their skills.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There's a pleasant wind today,
especially for the
height of summer.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: That's as good a start as any, I think.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Last year, Симболи Рудольф spent all her
time at
summer camp taking care of the
other students,
but this year...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
That's my intention. Naturally, I still have
student
council affairs waiting in the
wings...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But I thought it might be nice to
experience the
excitement of the first
day of summer camp for
myself.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Just like any other student of Tracen
Academy.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Well, it's about time for roll call. Let's
get started,
shall we?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
